tools.name: lookup_entity
tools.description: Resolve a player name, typo or NBA ID. Returns close candidates; choose an ID and state the assumed identity instead of asking the user.

tools.name: list_metrics
tools.description: List catalog definitions, units and observed season/phase coverage. Optional key or category filters; paginate with offset. Coverage does not certify complete seasons.

tools.name: awards
tools.description: Look up a season award or champion in the hashed NBA.com registry; no web fetch.

tools.name: finance
tools.description: Read an immutable contract book. Requires book_id, financial_season, known_at and effective_on. Independent of basketball scope. Unknown money stays unknown.

tools.description: CourtLens guide and routes. Omit topic for a topic index; pass its key for text.
